# home-depot-qbo-reconcile

> Keeps a contractor's Home Depot spending booked to the right job in QuickBooks Online. Each week
> an AI fetches every Home Depot purchase and return (with item detail and the printed receipt),
> drafts itemized QuickBooks entries per job — including the store-credit purchases, store-credit
> refunds, batch returns and cancellations a bank feed never explains — and posts them after the
> owner approves, so every bank-feed line is a one-click Match.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what to do for each request, what you need, where files live, the rules
- [ai/context.md](ai/context.md): every data shape and the 16 bookkeeping invariants

## Skills

- [ai/skills/hd-setup.SKILL.md](ai/skills/hd-setup.SKILL.md): set up for a new business (QuickBooks mapping into hd-sync.json, history pull, first sync)
- [ai/skills/hd-sync.SKILL.md](ai/skills/hd-sync.SKILL.md): the weekly sync — fetch, merge, draft, approve, post, close out
- [ai/skills/hd-job-audit.SKILL.md](ai/skills/hd-job-audit.SKILL.md): check one job's Home Depot cost against QuickBooks by month
- [ai/skills/cancellation-sweep.SKILL.md](ai/skills/cancellation-sweep.SKILL.md): card credits with no receipt
- [ai/skills/qbo-poster.SKILL.md](ai/skills/qbo-poster.SKILL.md), [ai/skills/receipt-log.SKILL.md](ai/skills/receipt-log.SKILL.md): the older ledger-first path

## Scripts

- [src/fetch_receipts.js](src/fetch_receipts.js): browser script, run in the owner's signed-in homedepot.com tab
- [src/merge_orderhistory.py](src/merge_orderhistory.py), [src/build_ledger.py](src/build_ledger.py), [src/gen_entries.py](src/gen_entries.py), [src/hdlib.py](src/hdlib.py), [src/closeout.py](src/closeout.py), [src/audit_job.py](src/audit_job.py): Python 3.10+, standard library only, all take --help
- [templates/hd-sync.example.json](templates/hd-sync.example.json): the owner's private config template

## Try it

- `python3 examples/run_sync_demo.py`: one whole synthetic week, no credentials or network
